text: The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are prophesying, and say to those who prophesy out of their own hearts: Hear the word of the LORD!
This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
Your prophets, Israel, have been like foxes among the ruins.
You have not gone up into the breaches or repaired the wall around the house of Israel, so that it might stand in the battle on the day of the LORD.
They see empty visions and lying divinations. They say, "Declares the LORD," when the LORD has not sent them, yet they wait for their word to be fulfilled.
Have you not seen an empty vision and spoken a lying divination, when you say, "Declares the LORD," though I have not spoken?
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have spoken emptiness and seen lies, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.

My hand will be against the prophets who see empty visions and divine lies. They will not belong to the council of my people or be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
Because, yes, because they have led my people astray, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and because when someone builds a flimsy wall they smear it over with whitewash—
say to those who smear it with whitewash that it will fall. A flooding rain will come; and you, hailstones, will fall, and a stormwind will break loose.

versions.text: say to those who smear it with whitewash that it will fall. A flooding rain will come; you hailstones will fall, and a stormwind will break loose.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew has an emphatic direct address (feminine plural pronoun) to the hailstones. "You hailstones will fall" reads as a stumbling phrase when spoken aloud; setting the address off with commas preserves the vocative and improves oral rhythm.

text: And when the wall falls, will you not be asked, "Where now is the whitewash you spread on it?"
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In my fury I will unleash a stormwind; in my anger a flooding rain will come, and hailstones in wrath to make an end.
I will tear down the wall you whitewashed and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is laid bare. It will fall, and you will perish within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
So I will spend my wrath on the wall and on those who whitewashed it, and I will say to you: The wall is gone, and gone are those who whitewashed it—
the prophets of Israel who prophesied concerning Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her, when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.
And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own hearts, and prophesy against them.

Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic bands for every wrist and make veils for the heads of people of every height, to hunt down souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and keep your own souls alive?[^1]

[^1]: The exact nature of the "bands" and "veils" is uncertain; they appear to be objects used in occult practice to ensnare people.

versions.text: Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic bands for every wrist and make veils for the heads of people of every height, to hunt down souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and keep your own souls alive?
versions.explanation: The Hebrew terms rendered "magic bands" and "veils" are of uncertain meaning and involve interpretive expansion ("magic"); a brief footnote helps the hearer/reader without altering the readable text.

text: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread, killing souls who should not die and keeping alive souls who should not live, by lying to my people, who listen to lies.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am against your magic bands with which you hunt souls like birds. I will tear them from your arms and set free the souls you hunt like birds.
I will tear off your veils and deliver my people from your hands, and they will no longer be prey in your grasp. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
Because you disheartened the righteous with lies, though I had brought him no grief, and because you strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he would not turn from his evil way and live,

versions.text: Because you disheartened the righteous with lies, though I had brought them no grief, and because you strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he would not turn from his evil way and live,
versions.explanation: The Hebrew suffix in הִכְאַבְתִּיו is singular, matching the singular "the righteous." The current "them" clashes grammatically with the singular antecedent and is inconsistent with the singular "he" used for the wicked later in the same verse.

text: therefore you will no longer see empty visions or practice divination. I will deliver my people from your hands, and you will know that I am the LORD.
